instruction:
Schema: products(id, title, price, stock)
Insert a single row with title='John'
output: INSERT INTO products (title, price) VALUES ('John', 100);

instruction:
Schema: products(id, title, price, stock)
Insert multiple rows at once
output: INSERT INTO products (title, price) VALUES ('John', 1), ('Jane', 2), ('Jim', 3);

instruction:
Schema: products(id, title, price, stock)
Insert into products from a select that filters stock
output: INSERT INTO products (title, price) SELECT title, price FROM products_src WHERE stock = 'x';

instruction:
Schema: products(id, title, price, stock)
Update the row with id=7
output: UPDATE products SET title = 'NewName' WHERE id = 7;

instruction:
Schema: products(id, title, price, stock)
Update all rows setting price to 0
output: UPDATE products SET price = 0;

instruction:
Schema: products(id, title, price, stock)
Update products increasing all price by 10%
output: UPDATE products SET price = price * 1.1;

instruction:
Schema: products(id, title, price, stock)
Update rows where stock equals 'done'
output: UPDATE products SET title = 'Finished' WHERE stock = 'done';

instruction:
Schema: products(id, title, price, stock)
Delete a row by id 12
output: DELETE FROM products WHERE id = 12;

instruction:
Schema: products(id, title, price, stock)
Delete rows where price is below 50
output: DELETE FROM products WHERE price < 50;

instruction:
Schema: products(id, title, price, stock)
Delete rows where stock is NULL
output: DELETE FROM products WHERE stock IS NULL;

instruction:
Schema: products(id, title, price, stock)
Delete all rows from products
output: DELETE FROM products;

instruction:
Schema: products(id, title, price, stock)
Upsert: insert or update on conflict of the id
output: INSERT INTO products (id, title) VALUES (1, 'X') ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET title = EXCLUDED.title;

instruction:
Schema: products(id, title, price, stock)
Conditional update using CASE
output: UPDATE products SET price = CASE WHEN price > 100 THEN price - 10 ELSE price + 10 END;

instruction:
Schema: products(id, title, price, stock)
Update a join-based target using a subquery value
output: UPDATE products SET price = (SELECT MAX(price) FROM products) WHERE price IS NULL;

instruction:
Schema: products(id, title, price, stock)
Delete with a subquery filter
output: DELETE FROM products WHERE price IN (SELECT price FROM products WHERE stock = 'skip');

instruction:
Schema: products(id, title, price, stock)
Insert with explicit column list and defaults
output: INSERT INTO products (title, price, stock) VALUES ('A', 5, 'active');

instruction:
Schema: products(id, title, price, stock)
Update with a LIMIT to only change a few rows
output: UPDATE products SET price = price + 1 WHERE id IN (SELECT id FROM products LIMIT 5);

instruction:
Schema: products(id, title, price, stock)
Insert ignoring duplicates
output: INSERT OR IGNORE INTO products (title) VALUES ('Dup');

instruction:
Schema: products(id, title, price, stock)
Delete a range where price between two values
output: DELETE FROM products WHERE price BETWEEN 20 AND 30;

instruction:
Schema: products(id, title, price, stock)
Update setting multiple columns
output: UPDATE products SET title = 'Z', price = 0, stock = NULL WHERE id = 9;

instruction:
Schema: products(id, title, price, stock)
Insert a row returning its id
output: INSERT INTO products (title) VALUES ('Ret') RETURNING id;

instruction:
Schema: products(id, title, price, stock)
Replace all occurrences in a string column
output: UPDATE products SET stock = REPLACE(stock, 'a', 'b');

instruction:
Schema: products(id, title, price, stock)
Trim whitespace then update title
output: UPDATE products SET title = TRIM(title);

instruction:
Schema: products(id, title, price, stock)
Lowercase a text column in place
output: UPDATE products SET title = LOWER(title);

instruction:
Schema: products(id, title, price, stock)
Bulk upsert with multiple rows
output: INSERT INTO products (id, title) VALUES (1, 'A'), (2, 'B') ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET title = EXCLUDED.title;
